_how: One free plan per plan reel. The comment-PLAN auto-DM (signup-site/functions/api/ig-webhook.js) reads the commented reel's caption and sends matteofights.me/plans/?p=<slug> for the first plan whose `match` phrase is in the caption (case-insensitive), else the PROTOCOL link. So every plan reel caption must contain its plan's match phrase, e.g. 'Comment PLAN and I'll send you the Lomachenko footwork plan.' Fighter plans also have `keywords` (first one is the CTA word, e.g. 'Comment LOMA'): a comment of up to 4 words containing one gets that plan on any reel. Items: [exercise, dose, how]. No metric units. Docs: docs/plans/README.md.

plans.title: Home Power Plan
plans.sub: 3 days a week, about 25 minutes, no equipment.

items: Explode up, land soft and quiet, reset between reps.
Jump for distance and stick the landing.
Push hard enough that your hands leave the floor, or as fast as you can.
Push the wall like you're trying to move it.
Rear straight driven from the back foot through the hip.
30 s hard combos, 30 s burpees, repeat. Effort 8 to 9 out of 10.
Easy skipping or jog in place
Pace where you can still talk in short phrases.

plans.title: The 9 to 5 Plan
plans.sub: 3 days a week, 30 minutes a day.

items: Fast and hard, full rest between sets.
Fold a towel, slam it down hard from overhead, hips drive it.
From a high plank, punch forward alternating arms, hips stay still.
Snap it back as fast as it goes out.
Side to side, stick each landing.
Slip left and right under a string or along a wall line.

plans.title: Power After 30
plans.sub: 3 days a week. Hips first, joints happy.

items: Squeeze at the top for 1 s.
Turn from the hips, arms just follow.
Every punch starts from the floor.
Lower back stays on the floor.
Pallof press (band) or slow plank reaches
Bag or shadow rounds, relaxed until impact
Loose arms, snap at the end.
Chest pass (ball or bag) or explosive push-ups
Band punches or fast shadow punches

plans.title: Fight Cardio in 20 Minutes
plans.sub: 3 days a week. Fights are bursts, so train bursts.

items: Last 30 s of every round all-out.
Easy jog, bike or brisk walk
Nose breathing only. If you can't, slow down.

plans.title: 2 Classes a Week
plans.sub: What to do at home on the other days.

items: Shadowbox the one mistake your coach called out
Hands back to your face after every punch.

plans.title: Keep Your Hands Up
plans.sub: 3 days a week. Your shoulders quit before your guard does.

items: Guard hold with light weights (2 lb or water bottles)
20 burpees, then 2 min shadowboxing hands up
The guard is the whole point. Hands drop, round restarts.

plans.title: Lomachenko Footwork, at Home
plans.sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by how Lomachenko trains, not his exact program.
plans.note: As a kid, Lomachenko spent about 4 years in traditional Ukrainian dance before going back to boxing. His footwork is drilled, not gifted.

items: Fast small steps on the balls of your feet.
Throw at a wall, catch with the other hand.
Slip or punch on a called cue
A partner or a random-call app says slip or punch.
Partner drops a ball, catch before the second bounce.

plans.title: Tyson Peek-a-Boo, at Home
plans.sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by the peek-a-boo style, not Tyson's exact program.
plans.note: Tyson's coach Cus D'Amato built the peek-a-boo style: high guard, constant head movement, punches from angles.

items: Tie a string between 2 chairs at chin height, slip left and right along it.
Bob and weave under the line
Gentle pressure with your hand, hold still.
Gloves on your cheeks, move your head before every punch.

plans.title: Khabib Pressure, at Home
plans.sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by how Khabib fought, not his exact program.
plans.note: Khabib wrestled from early childhood under his father. His pressure works because his cardio lets him keep it up.

items: Hips to the floor fast, back up to stance.
Drop your hips, not your head, then back to stance.
Any heavy bag or backpack, walk tall.
Hands on the wall, drive with your legs like you're pushing someone to the cage.
1 min each: sprawls, push-ups, squats, mountain climbers, rest

plans.title: Usyk Balance, at Home
plans.sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by Usyk's balance and coordination drills, not his exact program.
plans.note: Usyk's training videos are famous for odd-looking balance and coordination drills. That's the point.
